name: request-table
title: RequestTable
description: A virtualized table of requests on UI SDK's virtualizer, grid focus and resize: resizable, sortable columns, a waterfall with a playhead that moves without re-rendering, links to the other end of a call, and a size class of its own (bindSizeClass) that hides columns and goes to two-line rows when it is narrow. Stays smooth at 10,000 rows.
